# vtimestamp

> Decentralized document timestamping service built on the Verus blockchain.
> Users hash documents locally (SHA-256) and store the hash with structured
> metadata on their VerusID (a self-sovereign, protocol-native blockchain
> identity). Anyone can verify timestamps without an account. Documents never
> leave the user's device. No smart contracts required — timestamps are stored
> via native updateidentity transactions for approximately 0.0003 VRSC each.

vtimestamp creates cryptographic proof that a document existed at a specific
point in time. The proof is permanently stored on the Verus blockchain, tied
to the user's VerusID with structured metadata (title, description, filename).
Unlike centralized timestamping services, the proof survives even if vtimestamp
itself shuts down — anyone with a Verus node can verify directly.

## Core Pages
- [How It Works](https://vtimestamp.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step explanation of the timestamping and verification flow, privacy model, and why timestamps can't be faked
- [Compare](https://vtimestamp.com/compare): Detailed comparison vs OpenTimestamps, RFC 3161 TSAs, notaries, centralized services, and other blockchains (Ethereum, Solana, Cardano, Hedera, Sui)
- [Use Cases](https://vtimestamp.com/use-cases): Applications for intellectual property, legal documents, research, creative work, AI-era content authenticity, compliance, and personal records
- [FAQ](https://vtimestamp.com/faq): Common questions about privacy, cost, legal recognition, VerusID recovery, OpenTimestamps differences, and trust model
- [About](https://vtimestamp.com/about): Mission, Built-on-Verus differentiators, open-source info
- [Developer Docs](https://vtimestamp.com/developers): VDXF key reference, on-chain data structure, CLI verification (getidentityhistory and getidentitycontent), MCP server integration

## Tools
- [Verify a Timestamp](https://vtimestamp.com/verify): Public verification tool (no login required)
- [Create a Timestamp](https://vtimestamp.com/create): Create a new timestamp (requires VerusID login)

## Optional
- [GitHub](https://github.com/vdappdev2/vtimestamp): Source code (MIT license)
- [MCP Server (read)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vtimestamp-mcp): AI agent integration for verifying timestamps
- [MCP Server (write)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vtimestamp-mcp-write): AI agent integration for creating timestamps
- [Full Content](https://vtimestamp.com/llms-full.txt): Complete site content in a single document
